completion.detail: Play through all five chapters, from Gone Fishing to the final mission. The story takes roughly 60 to 80 hours, and everything you do along the way already counts toward the 100% checklist.
completion.label: Complete the story

completion.detail: There are well over 200 optional missions in Leonida. Any 100 count, so do the ones you enjoy and the ones near the places you already travel to.
completion.label: Complete 100 optional missions

completion.detail: Tail a security van to a bank, bring your partner to carry a bag, and rob the vault. Each vault can pay up to $205,000. Five vaults earn the trophy; all eight are needed for 100%.
completion.label: Rob all 8 bank vaults

completion.detail: Clear one gang operation for each of the nine gangs for the trophy, then all 39 for 100%. They are shown as yellow icons on the map.
completion.label: Clear all 39 gang operations

completion.detail: Bret texts Jason after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Collect the 15 Target Decks he marks, starting with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
completion.label: Collect all 15 Bret Target Decks

completion.detail: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 range locations.
completion.label: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges

completion.detail: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. You only need one win per location, not every race at each one.
completion.label: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations

completion.detail: Pull off 300 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights, and 25 base jumps. The trophy needs 250; 100% needs 300.
completion.label: Complete 300 stunts

completion.detail: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1). The trophy needs 100 scanned; 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.
completion.label: Scan 200 base-model vehicles

completion.detail: Study animals with the binoculars. You need 100 of the 255 animals for the checklist, so scan wildlife as you travel.
completion.label: Study 100 animals with the binoculars

completion.detail: Meditate at 15 of the 18 spots. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house first, because it is the only one that might be missable.
completion.label: Meditate at 15 of the 18 spots

completion.detail: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app. This is a separate count from the vehicles you scan.
completion.label: Scan 100 WAiNK locations

completion.detail: The 15 Bret Target Decks form three card sets. Collect all three sets to finish the card collection.
completion.label: Collect all 3 Target Deck card sets

completion.detail: Complete 70 of the 80 challenges. The trophy needs 50; 100% needs 70, so keep going past the trophy.
completion.label: Complete 70 of the 80 challenges

completion.detail: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations. Pick the shortest circuits and learn their lines.
completion.label: Win 20 different races

completion.detail: Discover 100 vehicles by finding them in the world and scanning them with the WAiNK app.
completion.label: Discover 100 vehicles

completion.detail: Visit every area of Leonida to clear the fog from the map. Flying by plane is the fastest way to cover it all.
completion.label: Fully unfog the map of Leonida

completion.detail: Complete eight stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, and Eddie do not count.
completion.label: Complete 8 stranger strands

completion.detail: Finish all five character questlines: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton (treasure diving), Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub), Randy (sports cars), and Tyrone (Synthetic Labs, Jason only).
completion.label: Finish all 5 character questlines

completion.detail: Hunt the animal Bret wants. The exact animal is still unconfirmed, so follow Bret's questline and check back for the confirmed target.
completion.label: Hunt Bret's animal

completion.detail: Rob banks and Payday Loans stores with the Dye Pack Jammer, then bring the marked bills to a fence. Yasmani pays the most.
completion.label: Launder $250,000 in marked bills

completion.detail: Spend $100,000 across the shops. Guns, car mods, and tattoos are the fastest way to spend it.
completion.label: Spend $100,000 across shops

completion.detail: Buy all eight purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app. They cost $160,000 in total, and you need them to register stolen vehicles.
completion.label: Buy all 8 garages

completion.detail: Register ten stolen vehicles through the Scooter Bros app by driving them to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choosing Respray and Register.
completion.label: Register 10 stolen vehicles

completion.detail: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt.
completion.label: Try all 9 activity types

completion.detail: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. His questline starts after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when he texts you a fishing location.
completion.label: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge

completion.detail: Finish one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
completion.label: Complete an arcade game

completion.detail: Call your partner, get a 4-star wanted level, and escape it. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route.
completion.label: Escape a 4-star wanted level on a date

completion.detail: Go shopping with your partner at three stores back-to-back while you are wanted. Three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well.
completion.label: Shop at 3 stores back-to-back while wanted

completion.detail: Kill five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 and R3 while aiming). Gang operations give you a group of enemies in a small area.
completion.label: Kill 5 enemies in one Combat Focus

completion.detail: Steal a large passenger plane from Vice City International Airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest to reach.
completion.label: Steal a passenger plane from VCIA

completion.detail: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station, on the south-west island in Mariana County. The tanks are parked in the south of the base.
completion.label: Steal a tank from Mile Zero

completion.detail: Rob Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City without being detected, using the Snap Gun to enter through the back door.
completion.label: Rob a jewelry store undetected

completion.detail: Rob an armored truck by blocking it, blowing the back door with a sticky bomb, and escaping the red heat radius.
completion.label: Rob an armored truck

completion.detail: Perform 500 criminal-profile actions. They happen naturally as you play, and you can see the count on the trophy itself. Avoid the actions that push you toward Irredeemable, which is permanent.
completion.label: Perform 500 criminal-profile actions

stages.blurb: Play the five chapters from Gone Fishing to the final mission. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house before the chapter ends, because it is the only trophy that might be missable. Everything you do in the story already counts toward 100%.
stages.title: 1. Story First

stages.blurb: Finish the five optional character questlines. They unlock as you play the story, and they all stay available after the credits, so there is no deadline.
stages.title: 2. Side Characters

stages.blurb: Work through the activities, races, and challenges. Most of these feed the 100% checklist directly, and several of them overlap, so one session can tick off several at once.
stages.title: 3. Activities & Races

stages.blurb: Hunt the collectibles and build your money. Scan vehicles and locations with the WAiNK app, meditate at the spots, collect Bret's decks, and launder and spend enough to hit the money targets.
stages.title: 4. Collectibles & Money

stages.blurb: Clean up the robberies, the exploration, and the combat trophies, then finish the 100% checklist. The platinum pops the moment the last trophy is done.
stages.title: 5. Cleanup & Platinum
